locked.why: Best development median error: regression with the 1 Jan 2026 just value 7.7% (2606 sales) vs just value x sales ratio 8.0%, regression without it 10.8%, neighborhood median 17.8%. Caveat: the just value is as of 1 January (s. 192.042, F.S.) but certified later in 2026; the test starts in April to keep later sales out of the appraiser reach, and the regression without it is recorded alongside.
